bio.en: Four friends from the foothills of the Alps playing airy indie pop. Their second album was recorded in an old barn - and that is exactly how it sounds: warm, honest and a little dusty.
bio.de: Vier Freunde aus dem Alpenvorland mit luftigem Indie-Pop. Ihr zweites Album entstand in einer umgebauten Scheune – man hört es.

bio.en: A duo with guitar, fiddle and two-part harmonies. Between quiet ballads and danceable sets, the two tell stories about life on the road.
bio.de: Ein Duo mit Gitarre, Geige und zweistimmigem Gesang. Zwischen leisen Balladen und tanzbaren Momenten liegt oft nur ein Taktwechsel.

name: Betonblumen
bio: Fast, loud, warm-hearted: Betonblumen bring three-minute anthems about small towns and big dreams to the stage.

name: Mondmaschine
bio: Analogue synthesizers, driving beats and a light show that lives up to its name. Mondmaschine traditionally play their set after dark.

name: Tante Groove
bio: A nine-piece band with a full horn section. When Tante Groove start playing, no meadow stays undanced.

name: Salzwasser
bio: One voice, one guitar and songs about the sea - even though the artist grew up far from the coast. Maybe that is exactly why.

name: Kometenkinder
bio: The youngest band on the bill recorded their first EP in the music school rehearsal room - and already sound like a big stage.

name: DJ Abendrot
bio: Closes the festival with a set of disco, house and favourite songs until the lights come on.
